metadata.sampleType: Complete Official NJ MOD-IV Class 2 Residential Assessment Roll (7,141 Homes)
metadata.disclaimer: Contains all 7,141 Class 2 residential properties (1–4 family homes, townhouses, and condominiums) in Township of Montville directly from the official State of New Jersey MOD-IV assessment roll (District 1421). All figures (Block, Lot, Qualifier, PAMS PIN, Assessed Land, Assessed Improvement, Total Net Assessment, Prior Certified Tax Billed, Year Built, Lot Size, Building Description, and Deed Sale Records) reflect official municipal tax records without synthetic interpolation.
